about: Open source security camera software for Linux, for IP, USB and analog cameras.

prs.title: Audit report rows link to their own camera
prs.broken: In the Audit Events Report, every row's event count link opened the events of all monitors, not the one in that row.
prs.changed: Each row now builds its own link for its own monitor, and a stale saved filter that hid the problem is cleared properly.
prs.matters: Checking one camera from the report now shows only that camera's events.
